Two years after the Threshold, the Commander's house: Nurah writes the sequel at the Commander's desk in the Commander's shirt and complains about the light. She read the bound book aloud in bed over four nights, arguing with her own sentences; on the fourth night she shut the book on the Commander's hand, climbed into the Commander's lap and demanded the Commander's attention elsewhere. This coda returns to that fourth night: gleeful, mocking and conspiratorial sex in which she leads, keeps her byline, sneers at the righteous who banned the book and treats the bounty on her head as the best review she ever got. Only Nurah and the Commander.
